name: posthoc-output-noise-as-robustness
trigger: random noise is added after model prediction and described as robustness/generalization improvement
risk: post-hoc perturbation changes submitted outputs but does not train a robust predictor; without seed it destroys reproducibility
gate: if robustness is desired perturb training inputs/model during controlled augmentation or optimize a robust objective
if output is stochastic model a calibrated predictive distribution
